verdict.rationale: Otter's own docs say the Mac/Windows desktop app records conversations bot-free, and that impromptu Google Meet calls can be captured without a bot present. That covers the core of device-side capture without a visible bot. However, nothing documents that external participants see nothing extra, such as no auto-shared summary emails, and no hands-on or independent report confirms that bot-free capture works as described. missing for 10: explicit documentation that participants receive no notification or shared notes in bot-free mode, detail on how device audio capture works, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, I can capture and transcribe meetings without a visible bot joining the call — audio is captured from my device so external participants see nothing extra

citations.quote: Record conversations directly from your Mac or Windows desktop, without bots joining the call.
